description: The donut chart illustrates the composition of the Darija Open Dataset Version 2, segmented into five distinct categories, each represented by a colored slice with its corresponding numerical value displayed inside. The largest segment, colored yellow, represents “Extra + Augmented Data” with 45,387 entries. The second largest, in light green, corresponds to “Pending Translations” with 43,000 entries. The third, in blue-gray, is labeled “Semantic Categories (e.g., Food, Economy)” and contains 30,000 entries. The fourth, in orange-brown, is “Syntactic Roles (e.g., Verbs, Nouns, Adjectives)” with 23,108 entries. The smallest segment, a thin purple sliver, represents “Moroccan Names,” though its exact value is not labeled in the chart. A legend on the right side matches each category to its color, and the chart uses a 3D effect with a central hole, emphasizing the proportional distribution of dataset components.
